["The packet does not hold a source that fixes whether Executive Order 13690's 2015 amendments to Executive Order 11988 (sections 2, 3, 4 and 6(c)) were in force on 2026-10-14. Chain held in the repository: EO 13690 (Jan. 30, 2015) amended EO 11988; EO 13807 section 6 (Aug. 15, 2017) revoked EO 13690; EO 14030 (May 20, 2021) states that EO 13690 is reinstated; EO 14148 (Jan. 20, 2025, held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_14148.txt) revoked EO 14030. EO 14148 is not citable as a later event from this packet (not in the chain or actor contexts), and no held source states the legal effect of its revocation of EO 14030 on the reinstatement of EO 13690 or on the amended text of EO 11988. HUD's proposed rule of July 10, 2026 (91 FR 42685, jobs/selden-fr-citers/output/texts/fr-2026-13939.txt) ties its proposed rescission of the rule built on the Federal Flood Risk Management Standard to EO 14148; that is a lead and not a source stating the status of EO 13690.", "The supplement for the 2015 and 2021 orders (80 FR 6425; 86 FR 27967) is listed as supplement_ready in HELD_SOURCES.json but is not part of this packet; EO 14148 would need to be added with them by the coordinator.", "The draft inventory has 25 clauses with irregular scope ids (sec2-i-3, sec2-i-dup2, sec2-i-4) and a lead 'order_heading_unresolved'; the clause list needs an inventory correction before each clause can be decided. Acting identity absent from census: NOTICE:1998-12-14; EO 12076 cited by number with no change provision located; target provision not located: EO 11514."]

["Sections 6, 7(a) and 7(b) (transfer of records, property, personnel and balances; the OMB Director's implementing actions; effective date of the transfers) are one-time commands whose own text makes the transfers effective on April 1, 1978 'or at such earlier time or times as the Director of the Office of Management and Budget determines'. No OMB determination, notice or other held source shows whether an earlier effective date was set, so the first end of these clauses is only bounded (not later than 1978-04-01) and cannot be recorded as an exact date in a v1 claim; Section 5's transfer of primary responsibility is continuing and Section 7's end date is the missing source.", "Inventory corrections are also needed: the dossier lists a spurious clause 'EO:12028#sec1-1977' (the OCR fragment '1977.'), omits Section 6 and Section 4(a)(4) (page break), and carries the pre-1979 Section 4 text that Executive Order 12122 replaced. Executive Order 12134 (effective May 6, 1979, before its May 9 signing) transferred the printing and duplication function in Section 3(b)(5) to the Department of the Navy.", "Operative status of Sections 1 to 5 itself looks supportable from the U.S. Code note to 3 U.S.C. ch. 2 (CURRENT:EO:12028#0, a custody record whose bytes are not held), which prints the order as amended by Executive Order 12122; it is the bounded end of Sections 6-7 that blocks the claim."]

["28 draft clauses, each of which amends or reassigns functions under another order. Each clause's state depends on the present text and status of its target order. The dossier's chain lists later instruments touching targets (for example EO 12149 revoking EO 11647, EO 12319 revoking EO 11331 effective Oct. 1, 1981, and EO 12156 correcting section 1(c) of this order), but a held current text of a target order exists only as CURRENT custody records (bytes not held) for EO 10485 (15 U.S.C. 717b note), EO 11790 (15 U.S.C. 761 note), EO 8526 (16 U.S.C. 835j note) and EO 11912 (42 U.S.C. 6201 note), plus 18 CFR 153.1 and 153.15. No held source shows the status on 2026-10-14 of the remaining target orders, so no clause-by-clause state can be sourced.", "Acting identities absent from census: PROC:4317, PROC:4341, PROC:4355, PROC:4370, PROC:4377 and others listed in the dossier's missing list; 'order_heading_unresolved' for the whole order; the clause inventory includes irregular scope ids (sec4-a-1974, sec4-i, sec4-i-ii).", "A defensible YES claim needs, for each of the 28 clauses, either a held-bytes current text for its target order or a held later instrument showing the clause performed or ended; the packet supplies neither for most clauses."]

["Sections 1 to 3 designate the Director of the United States Information Agency (the name inserted by Executive Order 12388, effective October 14, 1982). The Code note for the order says the agency was abolished and its functions transferred, citing 22 U.S.C. 6531, 6532 and 6551, and a Department of State notice of October 2, 2026 (91 FR 62802, FR Doc. 2026-20213, an actor context in this packet) exercises authority under EO 12047, the Foreign Affairs Reform and Restructuring Act of 1998 and Delegations of Authority 234, 236-3 and 523. The text of Pub. L. 105-277 div. G (22 U.S.C. 6531, 6532, 6551), which fixes the abolition date and how references to the Director are treated, is not part of this packet's dossier or held supplement (copies sit in jobs/source-ladder/output/texts but are not citable here), so the change of designee cannot be dated or cited as a later event.", "Section 4 (revocation of Executive Order 11312) and Section 6 (effective April 1, 1978) look performed by April 1, 1978 on the order's own terms; they would be recorded as terminated once the rest of the claim is sourceable."]

["Every section of EO 12058 delegates or assigns functions 'vested in the President' by named provisions of the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Act of 1978 and the Atomic Energy Act of 1954 (Act secs. 104(a), 104(d), 105, 309(c), 402(b), 403, 404, 407, 501, 601; 1954 Act secs. 126, 128a(2), 128b, 129, 131a(2)(G), 131b(1), 131c, 131f). A delegation lasts only while the delegated statutory function exists. The packet holds no current text of 22 U.S.C. 3201 et seq. (only the Code note), 22 U.S.C. 3223, 3224, 3261 or 42 U.S.C. 2139a, 2153a, 2153b, 2153c, 2153e, 2155, 2157, 2158, 2160, so whether each delegated function still existed on 2026-10-14 is not shown for each clause. Statute and reclassification text of 92 Stat. 120 et seq. is listed as 'held_needs_span' and 22 U.S.C. 3201 as supplement_ready in HELD_SOURCES.json, not in this packet.", "The packet's actor context FRDOC:2017-21357 (82 FR 46342, a Department of State delegation notice) is held but its effect on which Secretary performs each assigned function was not decided; it is not an amendment of the order."]
